comment: Flax seeds become juiceable in the vanilla fruit press, the same generic mechanism apples and olives use (see game:itemtypes/resource/pressedmash's olive entry). juiceablePropertiesByType resolves per-variant into a plain juiceableProperties on the flax item, same as shapebytype -> shape. litresPerItem below is a placeholder -- RudimentsModSystem overwrites it at runtime from Rudiments.LinseedOilLitresPerSeed in AssetsFinalize, same pattern as the barrel retting ratio.
